headline: First race calls: Democrats hold Virginia's Senate seat; early House calls in Kentucky and Florida
body: With the first polls closed across the East, the first race calls of the night have come in. The Guardian's live results tracker, which shows Associated Press race calls, has Democrats holding the Senate seat in Virginia. In the House, it shows Democrats holding Kentucky's 3rd district and Florida's 10th, and Republicans holding Kentucky's 5th. These are media projections, not official results; state counts continue and certification comes weeks later. Neither chamber has been called. AP says control of the Senate could take days to settle and the House up to about a week, with ranked-choice tabulation possible in Alaska and Maine. Democrats need to flip four Senate seats and three House seats to win control, according to AP.
